feed_content: "<div><div><div> <div><div><div><div> <section> <div><div><section>
  <div><div> <div><div> <div><h1><span>CHRISTOPHER GLEIN</span></h1></div> <div> <p><span><span><span>Scientist,
  Explorer, Communicator</span></span></span></p> <p><span><span><span>Planetary Science
  and Astrobiology</span></span></span></p> <p><span><span><span><a>christopher.glein@swri.org</a></span></span></span></p>
  </div> </div></div> </div></div></section></div></div></section><section> <div><div><section>
  <div> <div> <div><div><div> <p><span><span><span><span><span><span>Welcome! I am
  a geochemist who studies a range of topics in planetary science and astrobiology. </span></span></span></span></span><span><span><span><span><span>My
  research interests are centered primarily on the formation, evolution, and habitability
  of icy ocean worlds in the outer solar system. </span></span></span></span></span>I
  also want to know if there is life </span><span>elsewhere in the solar system and
  on exoplanets.</span><span> </span><span><span><span><span><span><span>I conduct
  geochemical modeling and laboratory studies to understand spacecraft data from planetary
  missions. </span></span></span></span></span></span><span><span><span><span><span><span>I
  work at Southwest Research Institute (SwRI) in San Antonio, Texas, and I work closely
  with NASA.</span></span></span></span></span></span></p> <p><span><span><span>​</span>​</span></span></p>
  <p><span><span><span><span><span><span>I would love to hear from you if you are
  interested in my work, or would like to discuss an opportunity to work together.</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
  </div></div></div> </div> </div></section></div></div></section><section> <div><div><section>
  <div> <div> <div><div> <div><h2><span><span><span>Get in Touch</span></span></span></h2></div>
  <div> <p><span><span><span>6220 Culebra Road </span></span></span></p> <p><span><span><span>San
  Antonio, TX 78238-5166</span></span></span></p> </div> <div><p><span><span><span>210-522-5510</span></span></span></p></div>
  <div><p><span><span><span><a>christopher.glein@swri.org</a></span></span></span></p></div>
  </div></div> </div> <div> <div><div><div><div><div><form><div><div> <div> <label>First
  Name</label> </div> <div> <label>Last Name</label> </div> <div> <label>Email</label>
  </div> <div> <label>Message</label> </div> <div><p><span><span>Thanks for submitting!</span></span></p></div>
  </div></div></form></div></div></div></div></div> </div> </div></section></div></div></section>
  </div></div></div></div> </div></div></div>"

Join the Mindlin Public Lecture featuring Chris Glein from the Southwest Research Institute on Feb. 25, 2026, at 6:30 p.m. in Johnson Hall. Glein, a geochemist specializing in planetary science and astrobiology, will share insights from his research on icy ocean worlds, particularly focusing on Enceladus, one of Saturn's moons. Attendees can expect an engaging discussion about the potential for life beyond Earth and the exploration of our solar system. This event is a great opportunity for those interested in science, space exploration, and the search for extraterrestrial life. Don't miss this chance to learn from an expert in the field.
